figurative_meaning_en: Something that brings joy to an afflicted heart
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিপদের মধ্যে তার সাহায্য আঁধারের আলোর মতো ছিল।
দুঃখের সময়ে সেই খবর আঁধারের আলো হয়ে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: His help was like a light in the darkness during the crisis.
That news became a ray of hope in the time of sorrow.
note: This idiom metaphorically represents solace in difficult times, common in Bengali literature for expressing emotional relief.
